name: Nyírkarász (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner charged near the top with the municipal arms of Nyírkarász (a green shield with a yellow charge, with a helm and red, blue and yellow mantling) above the name Nyírkarász in blue.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nyírkarász arms with helm and mantling
